name: Claus Manor map pictures
instructions: Process assets in table order, one built-in generation per asset.
Include the full Picture Standard followed by the Picture and prompt_clarification.
Inspect every reference, then attach every listed reference in array order, resolving paths under reference_root.
Create output parent folders as needed. Copy each generated PNG to output_root/file_name.
Inspect every result for scene details, matching reference style, wide 16:9 framing, and absence of text, people, characters and living creatures.
Verify saved PNG dimensions and SHA-256 against the generated source.
Preserve existing assets unless replacement is explicitly authorized.
picture_standard: This is for a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: friendly, funny, cozy and a little spooky, never scary. A WIDE 16:9 picture. No people, no characters, no creatures. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks. Nothing that looks like a famous place or character from a film, cartoon or game.
